paras: Cyrtodactylus hitchi  is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic Indonesia.
The specific name, hitchi, is in honor of Alan Thomas Hitch.
C. hitchi is found in Southeast Sulawesi province on the island of Sulawesi in Indonesia.
C. hitchi is a small species for its genus. Females may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 7.9 cm (3.1 in). Males are smaller, an example of sexual dimorphism, up to 7.0 cm (2.8 in) SVL.
The mode of reproduction of C. hitchi is unknown.
